prompt:
Our pharma competitive intelligence team is drowning in unstructured data about emerging biotech companies. We have two raw intelligence reports sitting in `data/raw/` — one covering gene therapy and AI drug discovery companies (`biotech_intelligence_report_june2024.txt`), and another focused on the regulatory pipeline (`regulatory_pipeline_june2024.txt`).

I need you to set up a new research tracking project for our 'Gene Therapy Landscape' initiative (use the project ID `gene-therapy-q2-2024`), pull both of those reports into the system, run the automated link-discovery analysis to surface connections between the intelligence items, and then kick off the self-verification workflow so our lowest-confidence data points get flagged for follow-up.

The tool for all of this should already be installable from the project directory. Please get everything set up and running.
